summary: The paper's own code (SLP framework on LLVM infrastructure) was NOT found on GitHub or any public repository. No code availability statement appears in the paper, and the lab website explicitly leaves url_code empty. Searches for the authors (YuhanShe on GitHub, only has irrelevant repos), system name (SLP Autotuner, speculative loop pipeline), and paper title all returned no matching code repo. The paper benchmarks against jianyicheng/HLS-benchmarks, which is an open-source HLS benchmark set from which nine programs were selected for evaluation; this repo was confirmed to contain HLS designs.
